phase_0.boundary_condition: The closed observational light cone contains the detection event and candidate source set as a terminal boundary nesting partners within a single container hierarchy.

⊢.justification: The null field prior to any transient event contains no signal record and no candidate source.

⊣.justification: The terminal boundary nests the detection event and candidate source set within a single container hierarchy.

≻.justification: The recognition mode composes functions from detection to candidate origin moving irreversibly or semi-reversibly toward source attribution.

≺.justification: The interface carries a signed direction where one pole accepts and the other donates enabling descent from candidate source back to detection.

⋈.justification: The recognition mode composes functions across the re-entrant distinction chaining detection to origin through sequential morphisms.

⊙.justification: The system sits at the critical point where correlation length diverges and the split-fuse identity recognizes itself.

∈.justification: The system selects partners disjunctively where any partner from the candidate set suffices opening one detection state into multiple source arms.

∋.justification: The mirror image remains accessible under the re-entrant distinction allowing the candidate arms to reconstitute into a single orientational state.

⊤.justification: The affirmative arm confirms the transient signal as a constructively proven detection within the light cone.

⊥.justification: The negative arm refutes the signal hypothesis when no candidate source registers above the noise floor.

⊞.justification: At criticality the split-fuse identity holds both detection and non-detection simultaneously without resolution.

⊡.justification: The measurement record is append-only and cannot be undone once fixed in the observational bank.
